method.description: Actual source and all chronological contact sheets inspected using view_image. Evenly spaced frames include 0, 4 and last. CPU FFmpeg decoding, filtering and PNG encoding limited to two threads each; no GPU or generation submission.

observations: The inspected source is a recognizable face-free cupcake with broad coloured wrapper panels, pink frosting, red cherry, green leaf and substantial coloured toppings.

Across 32 samples the cupcake gently rocks and the frosting/cherry sway together. The wrapper remains a coherent cup shape; frosting tiers retain their recognizable spiral structure without sudden sampled collapse.
Cherry, stem, leaf and all six coloured toppings persist through the sampled sequence. No eyes, mouths or other faces develop on the food or wrapper.

The full cupcake, including the stem tip and wrapper base, remains within the image in the inspected samples. No accumulating drift, clipping or sudden part losses are observed; colour relationships remain faithful to the source.
limitations: Sampled still-frame inspection, not real-time playback or inspection of every frame. Motion observations describe progression across samples; frame-perfect smoothness, inter-sample artifacts and seamless looping are not guaranteed.
Contact sheets use reduced-size frames; full-resolution extracted samples are retained beside them.
scope: Exact-source and exact-video sampled visual reward-video review only. No painting processing, build, emulator, imports or integration performed or approved.
